questions.question: Kathak guru, Shovana Narayan received the ___________ in 1992.
questions.solution: Shovana Narayan is a distinguished Kathak exponent and a disciple of Pandit Birju Maharaj. She was awarded the Padma Shri in 1992 and is recognized for her research and for adding a modern depth to the traditional storytelling of Kathak.

questions.question: Mohiniyattam is associated with which Hindu God?
questions.solution: Mohiniyattam literally means the 'Dance of the Enchantress'. It is associated with Lord Vishnu, who took the form of the celestial enchantress Mohini to help the Devas defeat the Asuras and recover the nectar of immortality (Amrita).

questions.question: Sudha Chandran is a known actress and an accomplished ___________ dancer.
questions.solution: Sudha Chandran is a renowned Indian actress and an accomplished Bharatanatyam dancer. She is particularly celebrated for her resilience and dedication to the art form, continuing to perform at a professional level even after losing a leg in an accident.

questions.question:
Which of the following pair of Thumri singing - characteristic is correct?
I. Poorab - fairly slow and staid
II. Punjab - more mercurial
questions.solution: Both statements regarding Thumri are correct. The Poorab (Lucknow/Banaras) style is known for being slow and staid with a focus on grace, while the Punjab style is more mercurial and vigorous, influenced by Punjabi folk melodies.

questions.question: The world famous Kathak dancer Pandit Birju Maharaj was the face of the Kalka-Bindadin gharana of ____________.
questions.solution: Pandit Birju Maharaj was the most iconic representative of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin gharana. This school is famous for its emphasis on Bhava (emotional expression) and Gat Nikas (graceful gaits).

questions.question: The famous musician Ustad Sultan Khan is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Ustad Sultan Khan was a world-renowned maestro of the Sarangi. He was a member of the Sikar Gharana and is credited with bringing this bowed string instrument from its role as an accompaniment to a respected solo status.

questions.question: Thiruvathira is a cultural festival of which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution: Thiruvathira is a significant cultural festival of Kerala, celebrated primarily by women in the Malayalam month of Dhanu. It involves the Thiruvathirakali, a graceful group dance performed around a traditional lamp.

questions.question: ‘Rongali Bihu’, one of the major festivals of Assam, is celebrated in the month of :
questions.solution: Rongali Bihu (also called Bohag Bihu) is the most important festival of Assam, marking the beginning of the Assamese New Year. It is celebrated in mid-April and signifies the start of the seeding season.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first woman to learn the all-male style of Kathakali and was also the founder of Darpana Academy Of Performing Arts that caters to various performing arts like dance, music, drama and puppetry?
questions.solution: Mrinalini Sarabhai was a trailblazer who became the first woman to master Kathakali, which was traditionally an all-male domain. She founded the Darpana Academy in Ahmedabad to promote various classical performing arts.

questions.question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, a musical genius, learnt which of the following gharanas of music from his father at an early age?
questions.solution: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a titan of Hindustani classical music. He was the most famous representative of the Kasur Patiala gharana, known for his incredible vocal range and the soulfulness of his thumris.

questions.question: The first Indian musician to receive the Ramon Magsaysay award for public service is:
questions.solution: M.S. Subbulakshmi, the legendary Carnatic vocalist, was the first Indian musician to be honored with the Ramon Magsaysay Award (1974) for her contributions to public service through her musical benefit concerts.

questions.question: Which of the following festivals is associated with Tripura?
questions.solution: Kharchi Puja is a major festival of Tripura, where 14 deities (representing the dynastic gods of the Tripuri people) are worshipped. It involves a ritual cleaning of the deities in the river Saidra.

questions.question: Who among the following is related to the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Kathak?
questions.solution:
Pandit Birju Maharaj belonged to the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin gharana.

Note: Guru Bipin Singh is associated with Manipuri, Sonal Mansingh with Odissi/Bharatanatyam, and Padma Subrahmanyam with Bharatanatyam.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian classical dancers, who popularised the Odissi dance form both in India and all over the world, received the honour of Padma Vibhushan in 2000?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was the legendary architect of the Odissi revival. In the year 2000, he became the first person from Odisha to receive the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.

questions.question: Ghoomar dance form was developed by which of the following tribes to worship Goddess Saraswati?
questions.solution: The Ghoomar dance was originally developed by the Bhil tribe of Rajasthan to worship Goddess Saraswati. It later evolved into a sophisticated dance form performed by women of all communities, including the Rajput royalty.

questions.question: Violin virtuoso L Subramaniam is famous for which of the following genres of music globally?
questions.solution: Dr. L. Subramaniam is an internationally acclaimed Violin virtuoso known for his mastery of Carnatic music. He is also a pioneer in global fusion, collaborating with jazz and orchestral musicians worldwide.

questions.question: Bhajan Sopori, a famous musician, is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Pandit Bhajan Sopori was a legendary musician of the Santoor. Belonging to the Sufiana Gharana of Kashmir, he is credited with adapting the instrument for Hindustani classical music through the 'Sopori Baaj'.

questions.question: Which of the following festivals is observed by the tribal people of Jharkhand?
questions.solution: Bhagta Parab is a tribal festival celebrated in Jharkhand during the spring and summer seasons. It is primarily a period of penance and worship of Budha Baba (the sun god or village deity).

questions.question: Which of the following classical dances is referred to as the dance of the storytellers?
questions.solution: Kathak is often referred to as the 'dance of the storytellers'. The word itself is derived from the Sanskrit word Katha (story) and Kathakar (one who tells a story), as the dance originated from nomadic bards in ancient India.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main percussion instrument used in the performance of Mohiniyattam dance?
questions.solution: The Edakka (or Idakka) is an hourglass-shaped pressure drum that is the primary percussion instrument in Mohiniyattam. Its pitch can be varied by squeezing the strings that hold the drumheads together.

questions.question: ‘Kalbelia’ is a folk-dance of which of the following states of India?
questions.solution: Kalbelia is a famous folk dance of Rajasthan, performed by the tribe of the same name. Often called the 'Snake Charmer Dance', it features swirling black costumes and movements that mimic the grace of a cobra.

questions.question: The Sattriya dance form was introduced in 15th century AD by ___________.
questions.solution: The Sattriya dance form was introduced by the 15th-century Vaishnava saint and reformer Mahapurusha Sankaradeva. He created it as a devotional tool for his Bhakti movement in the monasteries (Sattras) of Assam.

questions.question: Which of the following options best describes the meaning of Nritta in the Kuchipudi dance form?
questions.solution: In Indian classical dance theory, Nritta refers to non-narrative and abstract dancing. It focuses purely on rhythm, speed, and beautiful physical patterns without any specific poetic meaning or emotional storytelling.

questions.question: Which festival is celebrated in the month of February by the Angami tribe of Nagaland?
questions.solution: The Sekrenyi festival is the most important purification festival of the Angami Naga tribe in Nagaland. It is celebrated in February and involves rituals to ensure health and prosperity for the coming year.

questions.question: Hari Prasad Chaurasia, an Indian flutist, is associated with which of the following music gharanas?
questions.solution: While Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a global icon of the flute, he is technically associated with the Senia-Maihar (or simply Senia) gharana. His musical lineage traces back to the tradition established by the disciples of Tansen.
